# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to the AI Job Research Agent.

Please describe the problem the feature would solve and how you think it could fit into the existing architecture.

## Problem

What problem or limitation would this feature address?

Describe the current situation and why the existing behavior is insufficient.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you would like to see.

Include enough detail to explain the intended behavior without prescribing an implementation unnecessarily.

## Use Case

Who would benefit from this feature?

Describe a realistic example of how the feature would be used.

## Example

If applicable, show an example of the proposed behavior.

### Current behavior

> Describe or demonstrate the current behavior here.

### Proposed behavior

> Describe or demonstrate the desired behavior here.

## Architecture Considerations

Which part of the project would this feature affect?

- [ ] Requirement parsing
- [ ] Search strategy
- [ ] Job discovery
- [ ] Job normalization
- [ ] URL handling
- [ ] Deduplication
- [ ] Requirements filtering
- [ ] Job enrichment
- [ ] AI analysis
- [ ] Matching/scoring
- [ ] Ranking
- [ ] Formatting/output
- [ ] LLM provider integration
- [ ] Web discovery
- [ ] CLI/interface
- [ ] Testing/CI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

If you have an idea about how the feature could fit into the existing architecture, describe it here.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing features have you considered?

Explain why they do not fully solve the problem.

## External Services or Dependencies

Would this feature require any of the following?

- [ ] New API
- [ ] New LLM provider
- [ ] New job source
- [ ] New Python dependency
- [ ] Additional credentials
- [ ] Paid service
- [ ] No external dependency
- [ ] Not sure

If applicable, identify the service or dependency and explain why it is needed.

## Cost and Performance Considerations

Could the feature affect:

- API usage
- LLM token usage
- execution time
- rate limits
- memory usage
- network requests
- CI execution time

Describe any expected impact.

## Testing

How could this feature be tested?

Consider:

- deterministic unit tests
- mocked external services
- integration tests
- live tests
- edge cases

## Documentation

Would the following need to be updated?

- [ ] README
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `.env.example`
- [ ] Architecture documentation
- [ ] Other documentation
- [ ] No documentation changes expected

## Additional Context

Add any other information, references, screenshots, examples, or implementation ideas that may help evaluate the proposal.

## Checklist

Before submitting the feature request, please confirm:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] I have described the problem, not only the desired implementation.
- [ ] I have provided a realistic use case.
- [ ] I have considered how the feature could fit the existing architecture.
- [ ] I have identified relevant external services or dependencies, if any.
